## Checklist

- [ ] Commits and the title follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes (for component, style or playground changes)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Checked in light and dark mode, by keyboard, and at phone width
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (if a site would notice the change)
- [ ] README updated (if the public API changed)
- [ ] Breaking changes marked with `!` and explained in a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer
